messages:
oliver: heads up: deploy-bot flagged a multi-signal anomaly in eu-dedicated after rolling embeddings redwood-3.10.1. signals: embed_recall_delta=0.038 (below primary), customer-side drift + increase in semantic-mismatch alerts.

danielle: can you paste the deploy-bot summary?

deploy-bot: autoprobe summary: signals={embed_recall_delta:0.038, semantic_alerts:+12%, customer_mismatch:+0.6%}. thresholds={delta:0.04, alerts:+10%}. suggested actions=[hold, targeted-pin, rollback]. confidence=0.79.

rex: confidence low but combined signal set is concerning. is this only eu-dedicated pool?

oliver: yes, pools eu-ded-03/04. latency/p95 unchanged. replication on staging with production seed gave delta=0.035 and similar alert bump.

maya (support): we already have two customer tickets complaining about "search relevancy odd" since ~10:15 UTC. customers are on dedicated eu.

nate (pm): change window ends in 2h. if we rollback now we miss the gradual rollout plan for global. options: immediate targeted rollback, apply a temporary traffic pin to previous model for eu, or wait for more evidence (risking more customer noise).

danielle: propose: quick scoped pin for 1h while eng-ml triages. pin minimizes churn and keeps us in control. if the autoprobe re-triggers or customer_errors > 1% then escalate to automatic rollback runbook.

opsbot: suggested pin command:

```
redwoodctl rollout pin --pool eu-ded-03,eu-ded-04 --model redwood-3.9.7 --duration 60m --reason "scoped eu embed/alerts drift"
```

rex: who OKs the pinned duration? Usually ops + pm. nate?

nate (pm): OK for 60m. also need release-note blurb and support template. maya, can you prep short notice?

maya (support): on it. draft: "We detected a limited regression affecting embedding-based results in EU dedicated instances. We've temporarily reverted EU to the previously validated model while engineers investigate. There is no service interruption expected; results may differ slightly. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause."

danielle: legal reviewed similar language last week; keep "reverted" vs "rolled back" neutral.

opsbot: executing pin...

opsbot: OK: pin applied to pools eu-ded-03,eu-ded-04. ticket=RD-4901. live metrics adjusted.

oliver: monitoring windows: 15m short-check, 60m extended. If embed_recall_delta > 0.04 OR semantic_alerts > +10% sustained for 5m, escalate to auto-rollback.

deploy-bot: note: auto-rollback rule is enabled for eu-dedicated if combined_signal_score > 0.85. current combined_score=0.81.

rex: assign eng-ml to INF-9139 and add logs + staging bench. oliver you own triage.

oliver: ownership noted. starting diff-level model comparison and token-level embedding scatter. will update INF-9139.

maya (support): customer templates ready. sending targeted notes to affected accounts now. internal tag #eu-embed-pin.

nate (pm): timeline: if root cause identified and fix verified in 2h -> planned re-roll with canary gating. if not -> consider full rollback during the next maintenance slot (confirm with ops).

danielle: small follow-ups: 1) confirm CS ownership for any escalations, 2) product to prepare FAQ line, 3) ops to record pin command output in incident log.

opsbot: all recorded: RD-4901 appended to incident log. pin command output: SUCCESS.

oliver: early triage shows likely tokenization edge-case between v3.10.1 and v3.9.7 on long tails. pushing a narrower eval across the top ten affected customers.

rex: good. if we see repeatable regression localized to tokenization, maybe a model-config patch is faster than rollback. but pin is correct stopgap.

nate (pm): thanks. keep updates in the ticket. I'll brief account leads and legal if customer impact widens.

maya (support): customers notified. small replies already ":thanks", one asked for ETA. replied with "investigating, temporary revert applied, we'll follow up".

danielle: closing note: pin + targeted comms + 1h triage. escalate per auto-rollback thresholds. thanks team.

oliver: noted, marking deploy coordination done for now."
